capabilities: Pinch with two fingers to zoom notes in and out with anchored zoom
Switch between content zoom (CSS zoom on text, images and formulas) and font-size-only zoom
Zoom standalone PDF and image files opened in their own tab
Snap back to exactly 100% when a gesture ends within 5% of it
Show a floating zoom indicator and run zoom in/out/reset commands via hotkeys
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; install via BRAT or manual file copy. This plugin no-ops on desktop, where the author points to the separate companion plugin Ctrl+Scroll Zoom.
intentEvidence: Obsidian mobile has no built-in content zoom and no status bar, so this plugin adds
problem: Obsidian mobile has no built-in content zoom and no status bar, so there is no way to magnify a note with a pinch gesture.

relations.evidence: CodeMirror detects the scale and draws the caret/selection in the right place

summary: Mobile-only plugin that adds two-finger pinch zoom (content or font-size) to notes, PDFs and images on iPad, iPhone and Android.
